name: Invoicing
summary: Create invoices for CRM contacts, email them with a view-and-pay link, see when each one is opened, viewed and paid, and track what is outstanding.

screenshots.alt: Invoicing dashboard with outstanding, overdue and paid totals, open rate, and invoice rows showing opened and viewed counts

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Invoices
config.description: Organization invoices linked to CRM contacts, with email delivery and open, view and payment tracking.

permissions.label: Read encrypted invoices, payments and their open and view history for your organizations
Create, edit, mark paid, void and delete shared organization invoices
Read CRM contact names, emails and companies to bill a contact and show their invoices on the contact card
Email an invoice to its client only after you press Send
Record when a sent invoice email is opened, its page viewed or its pay link clicked, with the reader's mail client
Let anyone with an invoice's private link read that invoice
Ping the sender when an invoice is opened, viewed, clicked or becomes overdue
Add an Invoices page to the desktop rail to create, send and track invoices
